evidence.detail: Representative Zorin OS 17.3 validation passed 106 tests plus XML, platform-integration, and local source validation at the exact source revision.

The final lifecycle-tested local dev22 package passed install/validation, removal, fresh reinstall/validation, downgrade to accepted dev17, restore to dev22/validation, and final dev22 state without invoking a Care cleanup action.
Exact-source Care CI passed 106 tests, minimized privacy-status contracts, safe runtime flows, accessibility events, package inspection, and CI package lifecycle prequalification.
An earlier same-source local preparation build had a different SHA-256 from the final lifecycle-tested package, so reproducible-build byte identity is not established by this acceptance.

limitations: GoreeCloud Care remains Development / nonconformant and this runtime acceptance does not promote its application lifecycle.
Privacy Shield production_approved remains false until a separate governed production approval is completed for an eligible Care release candidate.

The acceptance covers only the declared telemetry-minimization, data-minimization, and privacy-status capabilities; it does not grant content-blocking, tracking-resistance, DNS, network, retention, deletion, export, or exception capabilities.
Byte-for-byte reproducible local package output is not established because two same-source dev22 local builds produced different SHA-256 values.
